blocks.en: CIRCUMCISION. Abraham's—a Token of Covenant, and Sign of Faith in the promise. Rom. 4:11, 12. (He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision.)
blocks.zh: 割礼。亚伯拉罕所受的——立约的记号、对应许之信心的印证。罗马书 4:11-12 —— 并且他受了割礼的记号，作他未受割礼的时候因信称义的印证。

grammar.note: the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision：他『未受割礼时』就已有的信——保罗论证因信称义先于礼仪的关键句。

blocks.en: Moral significance: Deut. 10:16. Circumcise the foreskin of your heart. Deut. 30:6. The Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart … to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart. Jer. 4:4. Rom. 2:28, 29. Circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter. 1 Cor. 7:19. Circumcision is nothing … but the keeping of the commandments of God. Gal. 5:6. In Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love. Col. 3:11.
blocks.zh: 道德含义：申命记 10:16 —— 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉（原文作要给你们的心行割礼）。30:6 —— 耶和华你神必将你心里……的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华你的神。耶利米书 4:4；罗马书 2:28-29 —— 真割礼也是心里的，在乎灵，不在乎仪文。哥林多前书 7:19 —— 受割礼算不得什么……只要守神的诫命就是了。加拉太书 5:6 —— 原来在基督耶稣里，受割礼不受割礼全无功效，惟独使人生发仁爱的信心才有功效。歌罗西书 3:11。

grammar.note: neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision：neither…nor… 双否定＋availeth（-eth 古词尾：有功效）；in the spirit, not in the letter：『灵』与『仪文』（letter 此处指字面条文）的经典对举。

circumcision.def: n. 割礼（circum- 环绕 + cis 切）

foreskin.def: n. 包皮（circumcise the foreskin of your heart：给心行割礼，喻除掉污秽）

availeth.def: = avails（-eth 古词尾）：有功效（avail：有益，GRE 词）

letter.def: n.【此处义】仪文，字面条文（in the letter：在乎仪文）；常见义：字母，信【四级】
